136:t_000:17.en:
$$デュオ$$
「That's great, but fighting the Empire's elite troops with these forces is still going to be rough.」

136:t_000:18.en:
$$デュオ$$
「$$カレン$$ and $$ゼクス$$ aren't here, and now even that other one...」

136:t_000:19.en:
$$カトル$$
「That's enough, $$デュオ$$. $$サイデリアル$$ is coming...!」

136:t_001:1.en:
$$リヴァル$$
「Even the $$黒の騎士団$$ might be in trouble this time...」

136:t_001:3.en:
$$ミレイ$$
「It'll be all right, $$ニーナ$$. The $$黒の騎士団$$... $$ゼロ$$ will never lose.」

136:t_001:4.en:
$$リヴァル$$
「Exactly! I stayed in $$新日本$$ to see the $$黒の騎士団$$ win, and the President stayed to report on it.」

136:t_001:5.en:
$$咲世子$$
「But this area could become a battlefield too. You should all evacuate.」

136:t_001:7.en:
$$咲世子$$
「Please don't worry about it. It's my duty to protect you all and this school.」

136:t_001:8.en:
$$デュオ$$
「They've sent a hell of a lot of troops...!」

136:t_001:9.en:
$$カトル$$
「The Empire must be planning to use this chance to take $$トウキョウ$$ in one stroke!」

136:t_001:10.en:
$$ギルター$$
「Heh heh heh... Tremble, Earthlings!」

136:t_001:12.en:
$$ギルター$$
「My name is $$ギルター・ベローネ$$...! I am the supreme commander of the force conquering $$新日本$$!」

136:t_001:13.en:
$$ヒルデ$$
(The enemy commander really did come...!)

136:t_001:14.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
(Everything has gone as planned so far. Let's see what you can do, $$ルルーシュ$$.)

136:t_001:15.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Damn...! They exploited a gap in our deployment, and we let this enormous force land...!」

136:t_001:16.en:
$$ギルター$$
「Don't be so despondent, $$ゼロ$$. You are not inferior. I am simply superior.」

136:t_001:18.en:
$$ギルター$$
「Your planet's military treatises say it too, don't they? Know your enemy and yourself, and you need not fear a hundred battles.」

136:t_001:19.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「You've even studied Earth's culture...! This man... He's different from our previous enemies!」

136:t_001:20.en:
$$ギルター$$
「You were only hailed as a genius in petty squabbles between Earthlings.」

136:t_001:21.en:
$$ギルター$$
「I, $$ギルター・ベローネ$$, am a renowned general famed for my cunning even in $$サイデリアル$$. Your old assumptions will not work against me.」

136:t_001:22.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「W-Wait, General $$ギルター$$...! With such a disparity in strength, we have no hope of winning even if we resist!」

136:t_001:23.en:
$$ギルター$$
「Oho... The great $$ゼロ$$ intends to surrender?」

136:t_001:24.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Of course, I wouldn't come empty-handed. I'll bring you all the information I have on the $$地球連邦軍$$!」

136:t_001:25.en:
$$ギルター$$
「So you intend to defect. You are a wise yet petty man.」

136:t_001:26.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「I'm not lying...! As proof, I'll send you the information I have!」

136:t_002:0.en:
$$ギルター$$
「Oh...! So this is the deployment of the $$地球連邦軍$$!」

136:t_002:2.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Shut up! If you don't want to die, do as I say!」

136:t_002:3.en:
$$カトル$$
「I misjudged you! You never used to be this kind of man!」

136:t_002:4.en:
$$デュオ$$
「Damn it! What happened to the $$ゼロ$$ we believed in?!」

136:t_002:5.en:
$$玉城$$
「Y-You're kidding, $$ゼロ$$! Stop it, $$ゼロ$$!!」

136:t_002:6.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「All of you, be quiet! Follow $$ゼロ$$'s decision!」

136:t_002:7.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Thank you, $$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$ I believed you, of all people, would understand me.」

136:t_002:8.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「We've known each other a long time. I understand everything about you.」

136:t_002:9.en:
$$デュオ$$
「Damn it, quit screwing around! Are you serious?!」

136:t_002:10.en:
$$カトル$$
「Then we'll have to stop him ourselves!」

136:t_002:11.en:
$$トロワ$$
「$$ゼロ$$! You'll feel our anger and sorrow!」

136:t_002:12.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「I have no choice...! We'll fight back, $$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$!」

136:t_002:14.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「General $$ギルター$$! Please support us!」

136:t_003:1.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「What are you doing, General $$ギルター$$?! I'm asking to defect to your side!」

136:t_003:2.en:
$$ギルター$$
「I simply cannot trust a man like you. I decided it was wiser to dispose of you here than let you become a problem later.」

136:t_003:4.en:
$$ギルター$$
「I already have the information I need, and your mutual distrust keeps you from coordinating properly. Everything is in my favor!」

136:t_003:5.en:
$$ギルター$$
「Now, $$インセクト$$s! Devour every last Earthling!」

136:t_003:7.en:
$$デュオ$$
「Does he mean those $$アンゲロイ$$s...?!」

136:t_003:8.en:
$$ギルター$$
「They are piloted by artificial soldiers created from the genes of this planet's insects.」

136:t_003:9.en:
$$ギルター$$
「Their aggression and discipline have made them excellent weapons.」

136:t_003:11.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「Now we have no choice but to fight, $$ゼロ$$!」

136:t_003:13.en:
$$カトル$$
「Let's go, $$デュオ$$, $$ヒルデ$$, $$トロワ$$! To hell with $$ゼロ$$!」

136:t_003:15.en:
$$デュオ$$
「Yeah! I don't care what happens to this country, but I'll be damned if I die here!」

136:t_003:18.en:
$$玉城$$
「D-Damn iiiit!! How did things end up like this?!」

136:t_003:19.en:
$$ギルター$$
「Ha ha ha! Cry! Scream! And die!」

136:t_003:20.en:
$$ギルター$$
「I, $$ギルター・ベローネ$$, will take $$トウキョウ$$! The legend of $$ゼロ$$ ends here today!」

136:t_004:0.en:
$$ギルター$$
「You're holding out remarkably well with so few troops...! Earthlings are stubborn creatures!」

136:t_004:2.en:
$$トロワ$$
「Isn't there anything we can do?!」

136:t_004:3.en:
$$玉城$$
「Hold on, $$カトル$$, $$トロワ$$! I'll give us a chance to turn this around!」

136:t_004:5.en:
$$玉城$$
「Shut up! I'm not taking orders from you!」

136:t_004:6.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Remember! $$トウキョウ$$ is a city rebuilt from the devastation of 《$$フレイヤ$$》!」

136:t_004:8.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「People have poured their hopes into this place... No one has the right to destroy it.」

136:t_004:10.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「What I had you prepare was strictly a last resort. The time for it has not yet come.」

136:t_004:11.en:
$$玉城$$
「C-Could it be... When you said you were defecting to the Empire...」

136:t_004:12.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Of course it was an act.」
